o.text: Contraction of kim isə. Equivalent to kim (“who”) + -sə.
From earlier *yüksük, from *yügsük, from Proto-Turkic *yüg~*yig (whence also Turkish and Azerbaijani yiv and dialectal Azerbaijani iv). Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *yü-~*yi- (“to sew”).
